text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Heave, ho...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Aaalright! That should do it for around 
here.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The soil over there looks ready. Shall we 
start sowing the seeds?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I wonder what kind of veggies we'll 
grow next... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, everyone! Most admirable, as 
always!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's the Chairwoman! Good morning~!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you did splendidly at the Great 
Harvest Festival! I too am eager to see 
what all of you will create next!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, hearing you say that makes me even 
more motivated! Alright, I'm gonna give 
today's farm work my all!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... The seeds are sown, watered, weeded, 
and mulched—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Th-There's nothing left!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!? A-And here I was planning to look 
all cool!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I want to show off how cool I am, 
but there's nothing to do here. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Why don't we just run?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but that sounds great! Let's just 
count this as our morning training!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm nicely warmed up from working in the 
fields, so the timing might be just right.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right, let's head out to the track!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Madam Chairwoman, please watch 
closely to see who's the fastest!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Toryaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Man, talk about full of energy... 
...Seriously.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, that is splendid! An Umamusume 
should never stay her legs when her body 
calls her to run!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Look. Everyone... they are running with 
such radiant expressions.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, whoa, whoa, whoa! Stop pushing, stop 
pushing!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sooorry! I got a little carried 
away!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. You're always scarfing down a ton 
of food, aren't you, Spe-san!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You feel the same way, Rice... 
...W-Well, as do I, of course!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll run hard to burn off what I ate! 
Fight-oh, fight-oh~!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
(...Run on forever, as far as you can. All 
of you.)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
(For the sake of the future only I can 
see. To seize my own dream.)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
(Every step of the path you run—is my 
dream itself!)
